biggest_catch: The new-user reward is only $5 of ETF shares (not cash), while Acorns charges a monthly subscription starting at $3/month — the fee eats most of the bonus within two months unless you keep investing. You also need a referral link from a current user; there is no public signup path for the bonus.
catches: The reward is $5 of Reward Shares — fractional ETF shares matching your selected portfolio — not cash; 'There is no option for a cash alternative to this Promotion.'
Acorns charges a monthly subscription fee (plans start at $3/month per third-party sources), so a passive account burns through the $5 bonus quickly.
You must complete an initial deposit or investment of $5+ (excluding Round-Ups) within fourteen (14) days after the end of the Promotional Period and maintain the account in Good Standing.
'Reward Shares are made at the sole discretion of Acorns' and Acorns reserves the right to change or terminate the promotion at any time with or without notice.
First-time Acorns users only; legal U.S. residents 18+; gift cards cannot fund the qualifying investment.
The September 21–27, 2026 '$1,400 for 5 referrals' bonus is for the referring client only, not the new user — do not present it as a signup payout.

steps: Get a personal referral link or invitation code from a current Acorns user — the bonus is only available through a referral, not public signup.
Sign up for a first-time Acorns subscription through that link and set up your Acorns User Account.
Open an Acorns Invest Account and link a bank funding source.
Complete an initial deposit or investment of $5 or more (excluding Round-Ups) in your Acorns Invest Account from the linked bank account within 14 days after the end of the Promotional Period.
Keep the account in Good Standing; the $5 of Reward Shares (ETF shares matching your portfolio) is deposited within 30–45 days of the initial deposit settling.
timing: Reward Shares typically deposited within 30–45 days of the date the initial deposit settles in the Acorns Invest Account.
